rule.statement: The District Court erred when it held that the application of the Plaintiff is barred by the provisions of Section 337 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rule.supporting_quote: I affirm the finding of the High Court that the District Court erred when it held that the application of the Plaintiff is barred by the provisions of Section 337 of the Civil Procedure Code;
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 337 of the Civil Procedure Code
